issue.title: Install python-gdb.py
issue.body:
I just had occasion to learn about and use `python-gdb.py` yesterday and it seems like it would be a good idea for pyenv to install it rather than requiring a builder to keep the source tree around.  Unless i'm missing something about the script requiring the whole source tree.  It gets generated directly in the root of the build right next to the binaries.

Hopefully I'll get a chance soon to look at adding this myself but I like to announce first anyways so people can weigh in and tell me preemptively if I'm on the wrong track.

rename.from: Poetry-managed virtual environment does not use symlinks on Unix platforms.
rename.to: Poetry-managed virtual environments do not use symlinks on Unix platforms.

body:
I was just wondering about this too, as I'm learning virtualenvs right now. Does poetry use its own version of `virtualenv` instead of using the Python 3.3+ `venv` module?

Workaround is to create the virtualenv with `python -m venv .venv` and then poetry will use that instead of trying to create one.

https://github.com/sdispater/poetry/blob/3dd09c2c53e39856577ac8b336d08f65791b0421/poetry/utils/env.py#L275
it's just using the standard python way. envbuilder for python3 and virtualenv for python2

@jgirardet the change would just be to align with normal `python -m venv` behavior. As seen [here](https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/d8080c01195cc9a19af752bfa04d98824dd9fb15/Lib/venv/__init__.py#L368-L371) they select the default `use_symlinks` based on platform, then [here](https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/d8080c01195cc9a19af752bfa04d98824dd9fb15/Lib/venv/__init__.py#L404-L409) they pass the derived option from the command-line (defaulted to `use_symlinks`) to `EnvBuilder`.
It makes sense so. i'm +1 on it
Doing a copy instead of a symlink breaks on OpenBSD due to the W^X protection, (typically only /usr/local has WXALLOWED enabled). Symlinking would fix this.

issue.title: use symlinks in created venv by default on non-windows platforms.

repository.name: poetry
repository.description: Python packaging and dependency management made easy

issue.body:
Fixes issue #779

As per the issue comments the change has Poetry align with normal python -m venv behavior.  As seen [here](https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/d8080c01195cc9a19af752bfa04d98824dd9fb15/Lib/venv/__init__.py#L368-L371). ie - the python binary in the new venv will be created as a symlink on non-windows platforms.
